title: SystemRecoveryPlan
description: How administrative control is recovered when no administrator is available. The system must not become unrecoverable because one person is unreachable.
x-notes: This table holds no credential and no instruction for obtaining one. It records WHETHER a route exists and whether it has been tested.

PrimaryAdministratorUserID.description: Left unassigned until the owner names a person. References Users.UserID

BackupAdministratorUserID.description: The simplest recovery route: a second administrator-capable account. References Users.UserID

RecoveryRouteDocumented.description: TRUE when a written recovery procedure exists and has been located by someone other than the administrator.

RecoveryRouteReference.description: Where the procedure lives. No credential, and no location of a credential. Validation: Required when RecoveryRouteDocumented is TRUE

BreakGlassAccountConfigured.description: Whether an emergency account exists that can be activated by a grant.

OwnerCanAuthoriseBreakGlass.description: The system owner can always authorise a break-glass grant.

LastTestedAt.description: An untested recovery route is a hope, not a control.

GoLiveBlocker.description: Stays TRUE until either a backup administrator exists or a documented recovery route exists. Go-live is blocked while it is TRUE.

IsActive.description: Soft delete. Rows are never hard-deleted; history is evidence.
